leagues.name: FIBA Basketball World Cup 2027 (and other FIBA events)
leagues.country: Global; 2027 World Cup hosted by Qatar
notes: World Cup runs 27 Aug - 12 Sep 2027 in Qatar, the first edition hosted in the Arab world (FIBA event page and FIBA event news, fetched 25 Sep 2026). Qualifiers run Nov 2025 - Mar 2027 across four regions.

Only two of the 32 World Cup teams are confirmed as of 25 Sep 2026: Qatar (qualified automatically as host) and Tuerkiye (first to qualify, FIBA news 'Turkiye qualify for World Cup', published 2026-08-31). The field is not set until qualifiers end in early 2027; the team list must be extended then.

Sponsorship story is event-level: national teams do not carry jersey sponsors, so the record is FIBA's own partner roster (10 FIBA Partners, 4 Global Suppliers) as league-partner deals, plus the Qatari state as event host (recorded in unsourced: event-host shape).

FIBA's partners page and the World Cup 2027 event page list slightly different rosters: Jetour is a Global Supplier on the partners page but appears in the FIBA Partners footer of the event page; the event news calls Jetour FIBA's 'Official Car Supplier'.
Venues per FIBA event news: Lusail Arena (final), Duhail Arena, Ali Bin Hamad Al Attiyah Arena and Al Janoub Arena (a 2022 FIFA World Cup stadium converted for basketball).
Host award: FIBA announced Qatar as 2027 host at its Central Board meeting in Metro Manila on 28 Apr 2023, by unanimous vote (Wikipedia lead; FIBA primary release not located).

owners.name: Chery Automobile Co., Ltd.
owners.note: Listed in Hong Kong (SEHK 9973) after its 25 Sep 2025 IPO. Per its HKEX prospectus (dated 17 Sep 2025): Wuhu Investment Holding is the single largest shareholder, 21.17% before the offering and 20.08% at listing; it is owned 95.59% by Wuhu SASAC and 4.41% by the Anhui Provincial Department of Finance. Anhui Credit Guaranty (wholly owned by the People's Government of Anhui Province) holds 9.97% before / 9.46% at listing; Anhui Investment Holding (wholly owned by Anhui SASAC) holds 5.20% before / 4.93% at listing - state entities about 34.7% combined pre-IPO, about 34.5% after the partial over-allotment exercise (5,808,604,533 shares total). The prospectus states the company has 22 shareholders with a dispersed structure and is not a state-owned, state-controlled or state-actually-controlled enterprise under the PRC state-asset measures. Jetour is one of Chery's marques.

owners.name: Inner Mongolia Yili Industrial Group Co., Ltd.
owners.note: Listed in Shanghai (SSE 600887). Per its 2025 annual report (published 30 Apr 2026): Hohhot Investment Co., Ltd. (呼和浩特投资有限责任公司) is the largest shareholder with 538,535,826 shares, 8.51%, shareholder type 'state legal person' (国有法人); the company states it has no controlling shareholder and no actual controller. A minority municipal stake, a much weaker state link than the Gulf cases.
